items.title: Inside F1’s ‘brutal’ fuel development race

items.title: Mekies offers update on Hadjar's injury recovery
items.content: Isack Hadjar has missed the three races since the summer break ended, sitting out Zandvoort, Monza and Madrid as he recovers from an injury sustained in training. The Frenchman hurt his wrist in the three-week break, and has been on the sidelines ever since.
